name: project-alpha
description: Helper npm scripts for running preprocessing and training tasks

scripts.preprocessing: cd preprocessing && cargo run --bin preprocessing -- --input ../data/raw --output ../data/preprocessed --resolutions fast,mid,slow --skip-existing
scripts.preprocessing:full: cd preprocessing && cargo run --bin preprocessing -- --input ../data/raw --output ../data/preprocessed --resolutions fast,mid,slow
scripts.preprocessing:memory-efficient: cd preprocessing && cargo run --bin preprocessing -- --input ../data/raw --output ../data/preprocessed --resolutions fast,mid,slow --skip-existing --batch-size 20000
scripts.preprocessing:unlimited: cd preprocessing && cargo run --bin preprocessing -- --input ../data/raw --output ../data/preprocessed --resolutions fast,mid,slow --skip-existing --batch-size 0
scripts.parquet: python preprocessing/test/describe_parquet.py --input data/preprocessed/fast/20231219.parquet --output preprocessing/test/parquet-output.txt && python preprocessing/test/describe_parquet.py --input data/preprocessed/20231219.parquet --output preprocessing/test/parquet-labels-output.txt
scripts.packages: python -m pip install -r training/requirements.txt && python -m pip install -r deployment/requirements.txt
scripts.training: python3 training/tcn.py --feature-root data/preprocessed --label-root data/preprocessed --resolutions fast mid slow --feature-set phase5 --primary-only --class-weight-power 0.5 --sequence-len 64 --batch-size 128 --epochs 15 --learning-rate 5e-4 --dropout 0.3 --tcn-hidden 48 --tcn-layers 2 --weight-decay 0.001 --logistic-threshold-min 0.5 --logistic-threshold-max 0.8 --logistic-threshold-steps 7 --val-days 2 --test-days 2
